processes.content:
name: Azure Architecture Audit
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/azure-architecture-audit.yml
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write

jobs:
  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - uses: azure/login@a641126d1b8aa4d1fa005f4f92df94a3a4c4c906 # v3
        with:
          client-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          tenant-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          subscription-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}

      - name: Audit Azure architecture without secrets
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          APP_NAME="binso-admin-prod"
          PG_NAME="binso-platform-db"

          APP_RG="$(az resource list --name "$APP_NAME" --resource-type Microsoft.Web/sites --query "[0].resourceGroup" -o tsv)"
          PG_RG="$(az resource list --name "$PG_NAME" --resource-type Microsoft.DBforPostgreSQL/flexibleServers --query "[0].resourceGroup" -o tsv)"
          echo "App resource group: ${APP_RG:-NOT_FOUND}"
          echo "PostgreSQL resource group: ${PG_RG:-NOT_FOUND}"
          test -n "$APP_RG"

          echo "=== App Service ==="
          az webapp show -g "$APP_RG" -n "$APP_NAME" --query "{name:name,state:state,httpsOnly:httpsOnly,kind:kind,location:location,identity:identity.type,clientAffinityEnabled:clientAffinityEnabled}" -o json
          echo "=== App Service identity ==="
          az webapp identity show -g "$APP_RG" -n "$APP_NAME" --query "{type:type,principalId:principalId,tenantId:tenantId}" -o json
          echo "=== App setting names only ==="
          APP_SETTING_NAMES="$(az webapp config appsettings list -g "$APP_RG" -n "$APP_NAME" --query "[].name" -o tsv | sort)"
          printf '%s\n' "$APP_SETTING_NAMES"
          OLD_MAIL_PREFIX="RE""SEND"
          OLD_BACKEND_PREFIX="SUP""ABASE"
          for retired in             "${OLD_MAIL_PREFIX}_API_KEY"             "EMAIL_DELIVERY_MODE"             "EMAIL_FROM"             "NEXT_PUBLIC_${OLD_BACKEND_PREFIX}_URL"             "NEXT_PUBLIC_${OLD_BACKEND_PREFIX}_ANON_KEY"             "${OLD_BACKEND_PREFIX}_URL"             "${OLD_BACKEND_PREFIX}_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY"             "STRIPE_PRICE_STARTER"             "STRIPE_PRICE_BUSINESS"             "STRIPE_PRICE_PROFESSIONAL"; do
            if printf '%s\n' "$APP_SETTING_NAMES" | grep -Fxq "$retired"; then
              echo "::error::Retired production App Service setting still exists: $retired"
              exit 1
            fi
          done

          echo "=== Production auth/mail readiness (no secret values) ==="
          APP_SETTINGS_JSON="$(az webapp config appsettings list -g "$APP_RG" -n "$APP_NAME" -o json)"
          node - "$APP_SETTINGS_JSON" <<'NODE'
          const settings=JSON.parse(process.argv[2]);
          const map=Object.fromEntries(settings.map(x=>[x.name,x.value]));
          const present=name=>Boolean(String(map[name]??"").trim());
          const readiness={
            appEncryptionKeyConfigured:present("APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY"),
            graphTenantConfigured:present("GRAPH_TENANT_ID"),
            graphClientConfigured:present("GRAPH_CLIENT_ID"),
            graphSecretConfigured:present("GRAPH_CLIENT_SECRET"),
            graphSenderConfigured:present("GRAPH_SENDER_USER_ID"),
            operatorEntraTenantPinned:present("OPERATOR_ENTRA_TENANT_ID"),
            operatorAllowedDomain:map.OPERATOR_ALLOWED_DOMAIN??null,
            graphSender:map.GRAPH_SENDER_USER_ID??null
          };
          console.log(JSON.stringify(readiness,null,2));
          if(!readiness.appEncryptionKeyConfigured||
             !readiness.graphTenantConfigured||
             !readiness.graphClientConfigured||
             !readiness.graphSecretConfigured||
             !readiness.graphSenderConfigured||
             !readiness.operatorEntraTenantPinned||
             readiness.operatorAllowedDomain!=="binso.ch"||
             readiness.graphSender!=="one@binso.ch"){
            process.exit(1);
          }
          NODE

          echo "=== App Service Authentication / Microsoft Entra ==="
          az webapp auth show -g "$APP_RG" -n "$APP_NAME" --query "{enabled:platform.enabled,requireAuthentication:globalValidation.requireAuthentication,unauthenticatedClientAction:globalValidation.unauthenticatedClientAction,defaultProvider:globalValidation.redirectToProvider,aadEnabled:identityProviders.azureActiveDirectory.enabled,clientId:identityProviders.azureActiveDirectory.registration.clientId,issuer:identityProviders.azureActiveDirectory.registration.openIdIssuer,clientSecretSettingName:identityProviders.azureActiveDirectory.registration.clientSecretSettingName}" -o json

          echo "=== App Service Authentication v2 via ARM ==="
          SUBSCRIPTION_ID="$(az account show --query id -o tsv)"
          AUTH_V2_URL="https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/$SUBSCRIPTION_ID/resourceGroups/$APP_RG/providers/Microsoft.Web/sites/$APP_NAME/config/authsettingsV2/list?api-version=2023-12-01"
          AUTH_FILE="$(mktemp)"
          trap 'rm -f "$AUTH_FILE"' EXIT
          az rest --method get --url "$AUTH_V2_URL" > "$AUTH_FILE"
          AUDIT_ENTRA_TENANT_ID="$(az webapp config appsettings list -g "$APP_RG" -n "$APP_NAME" --query "[?name=='OPERATOR_ENTRA_TENANT_ID'].value | [0]" -o tsv)" node scripts/azure-auth-check.mjs "$AUTH_FILE"

          echo "=== PostgreSQL connection from configured App Service setting ==="
          DATABASE_URL="$(az webapp config appsettings list -g "$APP_RG" -n "$APP_NAME" --query "[?name=='DATABASE_URL'].value | [0]" -o tsv)"
          if [ -n "$DATABASE_URL" ]; then
            echo "::add-mask::$DATABASE_URL"
            PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=10 PGSSLROOTCERT=system psql "$DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -Atc "select current_database(),current_user,version();" | sed -E 's/(PostgreSQL [0-9.]+).*/\1/'
            echo "=== Runtime database privileges (no credentials) ==="
            PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=10 PGSSLROOTCERT=system psql "$DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "select rolname,rolsuper,rolbypassrls,rolcreatedb,rolcreaterole from pg_roles where rolname=current_user;"
            echo "=== Tenant table RLS inventory ==="
            PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=10 PGSSLROOTCERT=system psql "$DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "select c.relname,c.relrowsecurity,c.relforcerowsecurity from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public' and c.relkind='r' and exists(select 1 from pg_attribute a where a.attrelid=c.oid and a.attname='organization_id' and not a.attisdropped) order by c.relname;"
          else
            echo "::error::DATABASE_URL is not configured; runtime isolation cannot be verified."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "=== PostgreSQL Flexible Servers visible to deployment identity ==="
          az resource list --resource-type Microsoft.DBforPostgreSQL/flexibleServers --query "[].{name:name,resourceGroup:resourceGroup,location:location}" -o json
          if [ -n "$PG_RG" ]; then
            echo "=== PostgreSQL Flexible Server ==="
            az postgres flexible-server show -g "$PG_RG" -n "$PG_NAME" --query "{name:name,state:state,version:version,location:location,publicNetworkAccess:network.publicNetworkAccess,delegatedSubnetResourceId:network.delegatedSubnetResourceId,privateDnsZoneArmResourceId:network.privateDnsZoneArmResourceId,authConfig:authConfig,backup:backup,highAvailability:highAvailability,storage:storage}" -o json
            echo "=== PostgreSQL databases ==="
            az postgres flexible-server db list -g "$PG_RG" -s "$PG_NAME" --query "[].name" -o tsv | sort
          fi

          echo "=== Storage accounts in App resource group ==="
          az storage account list -g "$APP_RG" --query "[].{name:name,httpsOnly:enableHttpsTrafficOnly,minTlsVersion:minimumTlsVersion,publicNetworkAccess:publicNetworkAccess,allowBlobPublicAccess:allowBlobPublicAccess,kind:kind,sku:sku.name}" -o json

          echo "=== Application Insights in App resource group ==="
          az monitor app-insights component show --app "$APP_NAME" -g "$APP_RG" --query "{name:name,provisioningState:provisioningState,location:location}" -o json 2>/dev/null || echo "No App Insights component named $APP_NAME"
          echo "=== Application Insights resources (any name) ==="
          az resource list -g "$APP_RG" --resource-type Microsoft.Insights/components --query "[].{name:name,location:location}" -o json
          echo "=== Metric alerts ==="
          az monitor metrics alert list -g "$APP_RG" --query "[].{name:name,enabled:enabled,severity:severity,scopes:scopes}" -o json
          echo "=== Scheduled query alerts ==="
          az monitor scheduled-query list -g "$APP_RG" --query "[].{name:name,enabled:enabled,severity:severity}" -o json
          echo "=== Alert action groups ==="
          az monitor action-group list -g "$APP_RG" --query "[].{name:name,enabled:enabled}" -o json

          if [ -z "$PG_RG" ]; then
            echo "::error::Configured PostgreSQL resource is not visible; backup/network readiness remains unverified."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Verify production monitoring gate
        if: ${{ always() }}
        shell: bash
        run: bash scripts/production-monitoring-check.sh

      - name: Verify restricted runtime database role
        if: ${{ always() }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          RG="rg-binso-admin-prod"
          DATABASE_URL="$(az webapp config appsettings list -g "$RG" -n binso-admin-prod --query "[?name=='DATABASE_URL'].value | [0]" -o tsv)"
          test -n "$DATABASE_URL"
          echo "::add-mask::$DATABASE_URL"
          PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=10 PGSSLROOTCERT=system psql "$DATABASE_URL" -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f scripts/sql/runtime-role-check.sql

name: CodeQL

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 4 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: codeql-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  analyze:
    name: analyze
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      security-events: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - name: Initialize CodeQL
        uses: github/codeql-action/init@9f759ee644a3e7c15c1390abf49868036c00067b # v3
        with:
          languages: javascript-typescript
          queries: security-extended
      - name: Analyze
        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@9f759ee644a3e7c15c1390abf49868036c00067b # v3
        with:
          category: /language:javascript-typescript

name: Deploy Azure App Service

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Quality"]
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: production-deploy
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
  id-token: write

env:
  BINSO_DEPLOY_SHA: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || github.sha }}
  AZURE_WEBAPP_NAME: binso-admin-prod
  AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP: rg-binso-admin-prod
  PRODUCTION_URL: https://binso-admin-prod-asctesfvhnd5b6ay.switzerlandnorth-01.azurewebsites.net

jobs:
  deploy:
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || (github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' && github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' && github.event.workflow_run.head_branch == 'main') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || github.sha }}

      - name: Resolve successful Quality artifact for this exact main commit
        id: verified
        uses: actions/github-script@f28e40c7f34bde8b3046d885e986cb6290c5673b # v7
        with:
          script: |
            const sha = process.env.BINSO_DEPLOY_SHA;
            const {data: branch} = await github.rest.repos.getBranch({...context.repo, branch: 'main'});
            if (branch.commit.sha !== sha) throw new Error('Only the current main commit may be promoted');
            const {data} = await github.rest.actions.listWorkflowRuns({...context.repo, workflow_id: 'quality.yml', branch: 'main', event: 'push', head_sha: sha, per_page: 100});
            const verified = data.workflow_runs.find(run => run.head_sha === sha && run.status === 'completed' && run.conclusion === 'success');
            if (!verified) throw new Error('No successful Quality push run for this exact commit; migrations and deployment are blocked');
            core.setOutput('run_id', String(verified.id));

      - name: Download Quality-verified production artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          name: binso-one-${{ env.BINSO_DEPLOY_SHA }}
          path: deploy
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          run-id: ${{ steps.verified.outputs.run_id }}

      - name: Validate deploy artifact
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -s deploy/binso-one.zip
          unzip -l deploy/binso-one.zip > /tmp/binso-zip-contents.txt
          grep -q 'server.js' /tmp/binso-zip-contents.txt
          rm -rf /tmp/binso-artifact
          mkdir -p /tmp/binso-artifact
          unzip -q deploy/binso-one.zip -d /tmp/binso-artifact
          DEPLOY_SHA="${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || github.sha }}"
          grep -q "$DEPLOY_SHA" /tmp/binso-artifact/public/deployment.json

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@b906affcce14559ad1aafd4ab0e942779e9f58b1 # v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install migration tooling
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Validate and migrate Azure PostgreSQL
        shell: bash
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.DATABASE_URL }}
          DATABASE_SSL: "true"
          DATABASE_SSL_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED: "true"
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "$DATABASE_URL" ]; then
            echo "::error::DATABASE_URL for Azure Database for PostgreSQL is required."
            exit 1
          fi
          pnpm db:migrate
          pnpm db:check
          RETENTION_DRY_RUN=true pnpm retention:cleanup

      - name: Azure login (OIDC)
        uses: azure/login@7184910d9eb2b1c5e48f7073824a90609bb9b6d6 # v2
        with:
          client-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          tenant-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          subscription-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}

      - name: Ensure production security and mail settings
        shell: bash
        env:
          BINSO_ENTRA_TENANT_ID: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          az_retry() {
            local attempt delay
            delay=3
            for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
              if "$@"; then
                return 0
              fi
              if [ "$attempt" -eq 5 ]; then
                echo "::error::Azure CLI command failed after $attempt attempts." >&2
                return 1
              fi
              echo "Azure API request failed (attempt $attempt/5); retrying in ${delay}s..." >&2
              sleep "$delay"
              delay=$((delay * 2))
            done
          }

          # Read App Service settings once. Repeated list calls can trigger Azure
          # management-plane throttling and unnecessarily slow every deployment.
          SETTINGS_JSON="$(az_retry az webapp config appsettings list \
            --resource-group "$AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP" \
            --name "$AZURE_WEBAPP_NAME" \
            -o json)"

          get_setting() {
            jq -r --arg name "$1" '.[] | select(.name == $name) | .value' <<<"$SETTINGS_JSON" | head -n 1
          }

          has_setting() {
            jq -e --arg name "$1" '.[] | any(.name == $name)' <<<"$SETTINGS_JSON" > /dev/null
          }

          OLD_MAIL_PREFIX="RE""SEND"
          OLD_BACKEND_PREFIX="SUP""ABASE"
          RETIRED_SETTINGS=(
            "${OLD_MAIL_PREFIX}_API_KEY"
            "EMAIL_DELIVERY_MODE"
            "EMAIL_FROM"
            "NEXT_PUBLIC_${OLD_BACKEND_PREFIX}_URL"
            "NEXT_PUBLIC_${OLD_BACKEND_PREFIX}_ANON_KEY"
            "${OLD_BACKEND_PREFIX}_URL"
            "${OLD_BACKEND_PREFIX}_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY"
            "STRIPE_PRICE_STARTER"
            "STRIPE_PRICE_BUSINESS"
            "STRIPE_PRICE_PROFESSIONAL"
          )
          SETTINGS_TO_DELETE=()
          for name in "${RETIRED_SETTINGS[@]}"; do
            if has_setting "$name"; then SETTINGS_TO_DELETE+=("$name"); fi
          done
          if [ "${#SETTINGS_TO_DELETE[@]}" -gt 0 ]; then
            az_retry az webapp config appsettings delete \
              --resource-group "$AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP" \
              --name "$AZURE_WEBAPP_NAME" \
              --setting-names "${SETTINGS_TO_DELETE[@]}" > /dev/null
            echo "Retired App Service settings cleaned."
          else
            echo "No retired App Service settings found."
          fi

          APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY="$(get_setting APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY)"
          SETTINGS_TO_SET=()
          if [ -z "$APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY" ]; then
            APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY="$(openssl rand -base64 48 | tr -d '\n')"
            echo "::add-mask::$APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY"
            SETTINGS_TO_SET+=("APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY=$APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY")
            echo "Stable APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY will be created."
          else
            echo "::add-mask::$APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY"
            echo "APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY already configured."
          fi

          CURRENT_OPERATOR_TENANT="$(get_setting OPERATOR_ENTRA_TENANT_ID)"
          CURRENT_OPERATOR_DOMAIN="$(get_setting OPERATOR_ALLOWED_DOMAIN)"
          if [ "$CURRENT_OPERATOR_TENANT" != "$BINSO_ENTRA_TENANT_ID" ]; then
            SETTINGS_TO_SET+=("OPERATOR_ENTRA_TENANT_ID=$BINSO_ENTRA_TENANT_ID")
          fi
          if [ "$CURRENT_OPERATOR_DOMAIN" != "binso.ch" ]; then
            SETTINGS_TO_SET+=("OPERATOR_ALLOWED_DOMAIN=binso.ch")
          fi

          if [ "${#SETTINGS_TO_SET[@]}" -gt 0 ]; then
            az_retry az webapp config appsettings set \
              --resource-group "$AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP" \
              --name "$AZURE_WEBAPP_NAME" \
              --settings "${SETTINGS_TO_SET[@]}" > /dev/null
            echo "Required App Service settings updated in one request."
          else
            echo "Required App Service settings already current."
          fi

          GRAPH_TENANT_ID="$(get_setting GRAPH_TENANT_ID)"
          GRAPH_CLIENT_ID="$(get_setting GRAPH_CLIENT_ID)"
          GRAPH_CLIENT_SECRET="$(get_setting GRAPH_CLIENT_SECRET)"
          GRAPH_SENDER_USER_ID="$(get_setting GRAPH_SENDER_USER_ID)"

          for name in GRAPH_TENANT_ID GRAPH_CLIENT_ID GRAPH_CLIENT_SECRET GRAPH_SENDER_USER_ID; do
            value="${!name}"
            if [ -z "$value" ]; then
              echo "::error::Microsoft Graph mail configuration is incomplete: $name is missing."
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "::add-mask::$value"
          done

          TOKEN_RESPONSE="$(curl -fsS --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 --retry-all-errors --max-time 30 \
            -X POST \
            -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
            --data-urlencode "client_id=$GRAPH_CLIENT_ID" \
            --data-urlencode "client_secret=$GRAPH_CLIENT_SECRET" \
            --data-urlencode "scope=https://graph.microsoft.com/.default" \
            --data-urlencode "grant_type=client_credentials" \
            "https://login.microsoftonline.com/$GRAPH_TENANT_ID/oauth2/v2.0/token")"
          node -e 'const p=JSON.parse(process.argv[1]);if(!p.access_token)process.exit(1)' "$TOKEN_RESPONSE"
          echo "Microsoft Graph client-credentials authentication passed."

      - name: Inspect production startup entry point
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          az webapp config show --resource-group "$AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP" --name "$AZURE_WEBAPP_NAME" --query appCommandLine -o tsv

      - name: Deploy to Azure App Service
        uses: azure/webapps-deploy@02a81bead70021f5284939794bcec79c271ab383 # v3
        with:
          app-name: ${{ env.AZURE_WEBAPP_NAME }}
          package: deploy/binso-one.zip
          # Each release is isolated from files left by earlier deployments.
          target-path: /home/site/wwwroot
          startup-command: node /home/site/wwwroot/server.js

      - name: Wait for deployed worker
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          DEPLOY_SHA="${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || github.sha }}"
          VERSION_URL="$PRODUCTION_URL/api/health"
          CONSECUTIVE=0
          # App Service may keep routing to the old worker until the new
          # Node runtime and authentication sidecar finish warming up.
          # Allow ten minutes, bounded by wall-clock time rather than retries.
          DEADLINE=$((SECONDS + 600))

          for attempt in {1..120}; do
            code=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/binso-convergence.json -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 20 -H 'Cache-Control: no-cache' "$VERSION_URL?probe=$attempt" || true)

            if [ "$code" = "200" ] && grep -q "$DEPLOY_SHA" /tmp/binso-convergence.json; then
              CONSECUTIVE=$((CONSECUTIVE+1))
              echo "Current commit observed ($CONSECUTIVE/2): $DEPLOY_SHA"
              if [ "$CONSECUTIVE" -ge 2 ]; then
                break
              fi
            else
              CONSECUTIVE=0
              echo "Waiting for all App Service workers to converge ($attempt/120)..."
            fi

            if [ "$attempt" -eq 120 ] || [ "$SECONDS" -ge "$DEADLINE" ]; then
              echo "::error::Azure App Service did not converge on $DEPLOY_SHA."
              cat /tmp/binso-convergence.json 2>/dev/null || true
              exit 1
            fi

            sleep 5
          done

      - name: Verify current production build and routes
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          DEPLOY_SHA="${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || github.sha }}"

          VERSION_URL="$PRODUCTION_URL/api/health"

          for attempt in {1..60}; do
            code=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/binso-version.json -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 20 -H 'Cache-Control: no-cache' "$VERSION_URL" || true)

            if [ "$code" = "200" ] && grep -q "$DEPLOY_SHA" /tmp/binso-version.json; then
              echo "Current commit is live: $DEPLOY_SHA"
              break
            fi

            if [ "$attempt" -eq 60 ]; then
              echo "Current deployment did not become active: $VERSION_URL"
              cat /tmp/binso-version.json 2>/dev/null || true
              exit 1
            fi

            echo "Waiting for current commit to become live ($attempt/60)..."
            sleep 5
          done

          HEALTH_URL="$PRODUCTION_URL/api/health"
          curl -fsS --max-time 20 "$HEALTH_URL" | grep -q '"status":"ok"'
          curl -fsS --max-time 20 "$PRODUCTION_URL/api/health/ready" | grep -q '"status":"ready"'
          echo "Binso One production health and readiness checks passed."

          BINSO_BASE_URL="$PRODUCTION_URL" node scripts/check-deployed-assets.mjs /tmp/binso-artifact

          retry_curl() {
            local output="$1"
            shift
            local attempt code
            for attempt in 1 2 3; do
              code=$(curl -sS --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 60 --retry 2 --retry-delay 2 --retry-all-errors -o "$output" -w "%{http_code}" "$@" || true)
              if [ "$code" = "200" ]; then
                return 0
              fi
              echo "Transient production check failure (HTTP $code, attempt $attempt/3): $*"
              [ -s "$output" ] && cat "$output" || true
              sleep $((attempt * 3))
            done
            return 1
          }

          DEMO_COOKIE_FILE=/tmp/binso-production-demo.cookies
          cleanup_demo_session() {
            curl -sS --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 --retry 1 --retry-delay 2 --retry-all-errors               -b "$DEMO_COOKIE_FILE" -X DELETE "$PRODUCTION_URL/api/demo/session" > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
          }
          trap cleanup_demo_session EXIT

          retry_curl /tmp/binso-production-demo-session.json             -c "$DEMO_COOKIE_FILE" -X POST -d '{}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'             "$PRODUCTION_URL/api/demo/session"
          grep -q '"ok":true' /tmp/binso-production-demo-session.json
          echo "Verifying demo session endpoint."

          for collection in customers customer_contacts products employees expenses documents payments; do
            echo "Verifying PostgreSQL demo collection: $collection"
            retry_curl /tmp/binso-production-data.json               -b "$DEMO_COOKIE_FILE"               "$PRODUCTION_URL/api/demo/data?collection=$collection"
            node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const data=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("/tmp/binso-production-data.json","utf8"));if(!Array.isArray(data.items)||!data.items.length)process.exit(1)'
          done

          echo "Verifying PostgreSQL demo finance."
          retry_curl /tmp/binso-production-finance.json             -b "$DEMO_COOKIE_FILE"             "$PRODUCTION_URL/api/demo/finance"
          node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const data=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("/tmp/binso-production-finance.json","utf8"));if(!data.payments?.length||!data.payroll?.length||!data.operatingCosts?.length)process.exit(1)'

          echo "Verifying team schema and PDF runtime."
          retry_curl /tmp/binso-production-team.json -b "$DEMO_COOKIE_FILE" "$PRODUCTION_URL/api/settings/team/invitations"
          node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const data=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("/tmp/binso-production-team.json","utf8"));if(!Array.isArray(data.members)||!Array.isArray(data.invitations)||!data.members.length)process.exit(1)'
          retry_curl /tmp/binso-production-documents.json -b "$DEMO_COOKIE_FILE" "$PRODUCTION_URL/api/documents?kind=invoice"
          DOCUMENT_NUMBER=$(node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const data=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("/tmp/binso-production-documents.json","utf8"));const doc=data.items.find(item=>item.kind==="invoice");if(!doc)process.exit(1);process.stdout.write(encodeURIComponent(doc.number))')
          retry_curl /tmp/binso-production-document.pdf -b "$DEMO_COOKIE_FILE" "$PRODUCTION_URL/api/documents/$DOCUMENT_NUMBER/pdf"
          node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const pdf=fs.readFileSync("/tmp/binso-production-document.pdf");if(pdf.length<1000||pdf.subarray(0,5).toString()!=="%PDF-")process.exit(1)'

          cleanup_demo_session
          trap - EXIT
          echo "PostgreSQL-backed demo and finance production checks passed."

          BINSO_BASE_URL="$PRODUCTION_URL" pnpm routes:css-check

          echo "Production URL: $PRODUCTION_URL"

      - name: Capture Azure diagnostics on deployment failure
        if: failure()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set +e
          echo "::group::App Service state"
          az webapp show --resource-group "$AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP" --name "$AZURE_WEBAPP_NAME" --query '{state:state,availabilityState:availabilityState,hostNames:hostNames,httpsOnly:httpsOnly}' -o json
          echo "::endgroup::"
          echo "::group::App Service configuration"
          az webapp config show --resource-group "$AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP" --name "$AZURE_WEBAPP_NAME" --query '{linuxFxVersion:linuxFxVersion,alwaysOn:alwaysOn,http20Enabled:http20Enabled,ftpsState:ftpsState}' -o json
          echo "::endgroup::"
          echo "::group::Recent App Service logs"
          timeout 60s az webapp log tail --resource-group "$AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP" --name "$AZURE_WEBAPP_NAME" --provider application || true
          echo "::endgroup::"

name: Microsoft Graph Mail Readiness

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/graph-mail-readiness.yml
      - lib/server/email.ts
      - lib/server/env.ts

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write

jobs:
  graph-mail:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: azure/login@a641126d1b8aa4d1fa005f4f92df94a3a4c4c906 # v3
        with:
          client-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          tenant-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          subscription-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}

      - name: Validate Microsoft Graph mail and submit self-test
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          get_setting() {
            az webapp config appsettings list \
              --resource-group rg-binso-admin-prod \
              --name binso-admin-prod \
              --query "[?name=='$1'].value | [0]" -o tsv
          }

          GRAPH_TENANT_ID="$(get_setting GRAPH_TENANT_ID)"
          GRAPH_CLIENT_ID="$(get_setting GRAPH_CLIENT_ID)"
          GRAPH_CLIENT_SECRET="$(get_setting GRAPH_CLIENT_SECRET)"
          GRAPH_SENDER_USER_ID="$(get_setting GRAPH_SENDER_USER_ID)"

          for name in GRAPH_TENANT_ID GRAPH_CLIENT_ID GRAPH_CLIENT_SECRET GRAPH_SENDER_USER_ID; do
            value="${!name}"
            if [ -z "$value" ]; then
              echo "::error::$name is missing from the production App Service."
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "::add-mask::$value"
          done

          if [ "$GRAPH_SENDER_USER_ID" != "one@binso.ch" ]; then
            echo "::error::GRAPH_SENDER_USER_ID must be one@binso.ch."
            exit 1
          fi

          TOKEN_RESPONSE="$(curl -fsS --max-time 30 \
            -X POST \
            -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
            --data-urlencode "client_id=$GRAPH_CLIENT_ID" \
            --data-urlencode "client_secret=$GRAPH_CLIENT_SECRET" \
            --data-urlencode "scope=https://graph.microsoft.com/.default" \
            --data-urlencode "grant_type=client_credentials" \
            "https://login.microsoftonline.com/$GRAPH_TENANT_ID/oauth2/v2.0/token")"

          ACCESS_TOKEN="$(node -e 'const p=JSON.parse(process.argv[1]);if(!p.access_token)process.exit(1);process.stdout.write(p.access_token)' "$TOKEN_RESPONSE")"
          echo "::add-mask::$ACCESS_TOKEN"

          PAYLOAD="$(node -e 'const sender=process.argv[1],sha=process.argv[2];process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({message:{subject:"Binso One – Microsoft Graph Produktionsprüfung "+sha.slice(0,7),body:{contentType:"Text",content:"Automatischer Binso-One-Produktionscheck. Microsoft Graph hat diese Nachricht im Auftrag der Mail-Service-App angenommen."},toRecipients:[{emailAddress:{address:sender}}]},saveToSentItems:false}))' "$GRAPH_SENDER_USER_ID" "$GITHUB_SHA")"

          HTTP_CODE="$(curl -sS --max-time 30 \
            -o /tmp/graph-send-response \
            -w '%{http_code}' \
            -X POST \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" \
            -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
            --data "$PAYLOAD" \
            "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/$GRAPH_SENDER_USER_ID/sendMail")"

          if [ "$HTTP_CODE" != "202" ]; then
            echo "::error::Microsoft Graph sendMail returned HTTP $HTTP_CODE."
            cat /tmp/graph-send-response
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Microsoft Graph accepted a production self-test email from one@binso.ch."

name: PostgreSQL Backup Readiness

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/postgresql-backup-readiness.yml
      - docs/azure-postgresql-backup-restore.md

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write

jobs:
  backup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: azure/login@a641126d1b8aa4d1fa005f4f92df94a3a4c4c906 # v3
        with:
          client-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          tenant-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          subscription-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}

      - name: Verify Azure PostgreSQL backup configuration
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          SERVER="binso-platform-db"
          RG="$(az resource list --name "$SERVER" --resource-type Microsoft.DBforPostgreSQL/flexibleServers --query "[0].resourceGroup" -o tsv)"
          if [ -z "$RG" ]; then
            echo "::error::Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server was not found."
            exit 1
          fi

          RETENTION="$(az postgres flexible-server show -g "$RG" -n "$SERVER" --query "backup.backupRetentionDays" -o tsv)"
          GEO="$(az postgres flexible-server show -g "$RG" -n "$SERVER" --query "backup.geoRedundantBackup" -o tsv)"
          STATE="$(az postgres flexible-server show -g "$RG" -n "$SERVER" --query "state" -o tsv)"

          echo "Server state: $STATE"
          echo "Backup retention days: $RETENTION"
          echo "Geo-redundant backup: $GEO"

          if [ "$STATE" != "Ready" ]; then
            echo "::error::PostgreSQL server is not Ready."
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -z "$RETENTION" ] || [ "$RETENTION" -lt 7 ]; then
            echo "::error::Backup retention must be at least 7 days."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Backup configuration gate passed. A real point-in-time restore test is still required before commercial go-live."

name: Quality
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      level:
        description: QA coverage
        type: choice
        options: [standard, full]
        default: full
  schedule:
    - cron: '23 3 * * 0'
  release:
    types: [published]
concurrency:
  group: quality-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
permissions:
  contents: read
env:
  BINSO_BUILD_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
jobs:
  plan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      level: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.level }}
      routes: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.routes }}
      webkit_routes: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.webkit_routes }}
      widths: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.widths }}
      webkit_widths: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.webkit_widths }}
      interactions: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.interactions }}
      browser: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.browser }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - name: Select conservative QA scope
        id: scope
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before }}
          FORCE_FULL: ${{ github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'release' || inputs.level == 'full' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          LEVEL=standard
          if [ "$FORCE_FULL" = true ]; then LEVEL=full; fi
          if [ -n "$BASE_SHA" ] && git cat-file -e "$BASE_SHA^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
            node scripts/qa-plan.mjs --level "$LEVEL" --base "$BASE_SHA" | tee /tmp/qa-plan.json
          else
            node scripts/qa-plan.mjs --level full | tee /tmp/qa-plan.json
          fi
          cat /tmp/qa-plan.json >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: public.ecr.aws/docker/library/postgres:16 # Docker Official Image; avoids shared Docker Hub pull quota
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: binso_test
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: binso_test
          POSTGRES_DB: binso_v213_test
        ports: ['5432:5432']
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U binso_test -d binso_v213_test"
          --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 10
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-node
      - run: pnpm release:check
      - run: pnpm test
      - name: Fast UX compliance contracts
        run: pnpm ux:compliance:fast
      - name: Real isolated PostgreSQL parallel process gate
        env:
          BINSO_DB_PARALLEL_TEST_URL: postgres://binso_test:binso_test@127.0.0.1:5432/binso_v213_test
        run: |
          node scripts/postgres-parallel-test.mjs
          node scripts/auth-integrity-test.mjs --postgres
          node scripts/registration-test.mjs --postgres
      - run: pnpm lint
      - run: pnpm css:check
      - run: pnpm typecheck
      - name: Record successful scoped architecture lint evidence
        run: |
          mkdir -p evidence/static
          node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from "node:fs";import {identity} from "./scripts/compliance/identity.mjs";fs.writeFileSync("evidence/static/compliance-lint.json",JSON.stringify({schemaVersion:1,...identity(),route:"customer-app",state:"source",checks:[{id:"UX-ARC-001",status:"passed",observed:{command:"pnpm lint",exit:0,scope:"existing central-ui owner rules; full lint"}}]}));'
      - name: Upload architecture lint evidence
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: ux-static-${{ github.sha }}
          path: evidence/static
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
      - run: pnpm security:scan
      - name: Full dependency audit including development tooling
        run: pnpm security:scan:all
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: public.ecr.aws/docker/library/postgres:16 # Docker Official Image; avoids shared Docker Hub pull quota
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: binso_test
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: binso_test
          POSTGRES_DB: binso_v213_test
        ports: ['5432:5432']
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U binso_test -d binso_v213_test"
          --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 10
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-node
      - name: Restore Next compiler cache (never a completed build)
        uses: actions/cache@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830 # v4
        with:
          path: .next/cache
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-node24-next-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml', 'next.config.*') }}-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-node24-next-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml', 'next.config.*') }}-
      - run: pnpm build
      - name: Authenticated tenant, role and session HTTP gate
        env:
          BINSO_DB_PARALLEL_TEST_URL: postgres://binso_test:binso_test@127.0.0.1:5432/binso_v213_test
        run: node scripts/api-tenant-postgres-test.mjs
      - name: Anonymous API authorization surface
        run: node scripts/api-auth-surface-test.mjs
      - name: Runtime smoke test
        run: bash scripts/runtime-smoke.sh
      - name: Package production candidate
        run: bash scripts/package-production.sh
      - name: Smoke test exact production artifact
        run: bash scripts/smoke-production-artifact.sh
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: binso-candidate-${{ github.sha }}
          path: deploy/binso-one.zip
          if-no-files-found: error
          compression-level: 0
          retention-days: 2
  browser:
    services:
      postgres:
        image: public.ecr.aws/docker/library/postgres:16
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: binso_test
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: binso_test
          POSTGRES_DB: binso_observability_test
        ports: ['5432:5432']
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U binso_test -d binso_observability_test"
          --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 10
    needs: [plan, build]
    if: needs.plan.outputs.browser == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Full UX, real 60-second recovery polling, registration and PWA gates share this job.
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        engine: [chromium, webkit]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-node
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          name: binso-candidate-${{ github.sha }}
          path: deploy
      - name: Extract exact production candidate
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/binso-candidate"
          unzip -q deploy/binso-one.zip -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/binso-candidate"
      - name: Restore pinned browser binaries
        id: browser-cache
        uses: actions/cache/restore@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830 # v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-playwright-1.62.1-${{ matrix.engine }}
      - name: Install one browser engine
        env:
          ENGINE: ${{ matrix.engine }}
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/binso-browser" --no-package-lock --ignore-scripts playwright@1.62.1 axe-core@4.11.0
          if [ "$ENGINE" = chromium ]; then
            node "$RUNNER_TEMP/binso-browser/node_modules/playwright/cli.js" install --with-deps --only-shell chromium
          else
            node "$RUNNER_TEMP/binso-browser/node_modules/playwright/cli.js" install --with-deps webkit
          fi
      - name: Save installed browser binaries
        if: steps.browser-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        uses: actions/cache/save@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830 # v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-playwright-1.62.1-${{ matrix.engine }}
      - name: Scroll endpoint measurement adversaries
        env:
          BINSO_PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE: ${{ runner.temp }}/binso-browser/node_modules/playwright/index.mjs
          BINSO_UX_BROWSER: ${{ matrix.engine }}
        run: node scripts/compliance/measure-browser-test.mjs
      - name: Scoped responsive UX and process regression
        env:
          BINSO_PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE: ${{ runner.temp }}/binso-browser/node_modules/playwright/index.mjs
          BINSO_AXE_MODULE: ${{ runner.temp }}/binso-browser/node_modules/axe-core/axe.min.js
          BINSO_UX_A11Y: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.level == 'full' && '1' || '0' }}
          BINSO_UX_BROWSER: ${{ matrix.engine }}
          BINSO_UX_DEVICE: ${{ matrix.engine == 'webkit' && 'iPhone 13' || '' }}
          BINSO_UX_ROUTES: ${{ matrix.engine == 'webkit' && needs.plan.outputs.webkit_routes || needs.plan.outputs.routes }}
          BINSO_UX_WIDTHS: ${{ matrix.engine == 'webkit' && needs.plan.outputs.webkit_widths || needs.plan.outputs.widths }}
          BINSO_UX_INTERACTIONS: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.interactions }}
          BINSO_UX_SCREENSHOTS: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.level == 'full' && '1' || '0' }}
          BINSO_UX_DOM_EVIDENCE: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.level == 'full' && '1' || '0' }}
          BINSO_UX_CAPTURE_ALL: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.level == 'full' && '1' || '0' }}
          BINSO_UX_COMPLIANCE: '1'
          BINSO_UX_OUTPUT: ${{ runner.temp }}/binso-ux-${{ matrix.engine }}
          BINSO_UX_SERVER_FILE: ${{ runner.temp }}/binso-candidate/server.js
        run: node scripts/browser-shards.mjs
      - name: Deterministic synthetic data and role variants
        if: matrix.engine == 'chromium' && needs.plan.outputs.level == 'full'
        env:
          BINSO_PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE: ${{ runner.temp }}/binso-browser/node_modules/playwright/index.mjs
          BINSO_UX_SERVER_FILE: ${{ runner.temp }}/binso-candidate/server.js
          BINSO_UX_COMPLIANCE: '1'
          BINSO_UX_MATRIX_ONLY: '1'
          BINSO_UX_THEMES: light
          BINSO_UX_WIDTHS: '390'
          BINSO_UX_SCREENSHOTS: '0'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          INDEX=0
          for FIXTURE in empty large partial negative no-expenses admin finance employee; do
            ROUTES=/kunden
            case "$FIXTURE" in
              empty) ROUTES=/kunden,/finanzen ;;
              partial) ROUTES=/rechnungen ;;
              negative|no-expenses|finance) ROUTES=/finanzen ;;
              employee) ROUTES=/zeit ;;
            esac
            BINSO_UX_FIXTURE_CASE="$FIXTURE" BINSO_UX_ROUTES="$ROUTES" BINSO_UX_PORT="$((3600 + INDEX * 2))" BINSO_UX_OUTPUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/binso-ux-chromium/fixtures/$FIXTURE" node scripts/ux-browser-test.mjs
            INDEX=$((INDEX + 1))
          done
      - name: Authenticated observability and wallboard regression
        env:
          BINSO_OBSERVABILITY_TEST_URL: postgres://binso_test:binso_test@127.0.0.1:5432/binso_observability_test
          BINSO_PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE: ${{ runner.temp }}/binso-browser/node_modules/playwright/index.mjs
          BINSO_UX_BROWSER: ${{ matrix.engine }}
          BINSO_OBSERVABILITY_OUTPUT: ${{ runner.temp }}/binso-ux-${{ matrix.engine }}/observability
          BINSO_UX_SERVER_FILE: ${{ runner.temp }}/binso-candidate/server.js
        run: node scripts/observability-browser-test.mjs
      - name: Guided registration, languages and responsive regression
        env:
          BINSO_PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE: ${{ runner.temp }}/binso-browser/node_modules/playwright/index.mjs
          BINSO_AXE_MODULE: ${{ runner.temp }}/binso-browser/node_modules/axe-core/axe.min.js
          BINSO_UX_BROWSER: ${{ matrix.engine }}
          BINSO_REGISTRATION_WIDTHS: ${{ matrix.engine == 'webkit' && '375,390,430' || '320,360,375,390,430,768,820,1024,1280,1440,1920' }}
          BINSO_REGISTRATION_OUTPUT: ${{ runner.temp }}/binso-ux-${{ matrix.engine }}/registration
          BINSO_UX_SERVER_FILE: ${{ runner.temp }}/binso-candidate/server.js
        run: node scripts/registration-browser-test.mjs
      - name: Development-only shared component reference regression
        if: matrix.engine == 'chromium' && needs.plan.outputs.level == 'full'
        env:
          BINSO_PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE: ${{ runner.temp }}/binso-browser/node_modules/playwright/index.mjs
          BINSO_LAB_OUTPUT: ${{ runner.temp }}/binso-ux-${{ matrix.engine }}/lab
        run: pnpm ux:lab
      - name: FULL PWA restart and offline regression
        if: matrix.engine == 'chromium' && needs.plan.outputs.level == 'full'
        env:
          BINSO_PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE: ${{ runner.temp }}/binso-browser/node_modules/playwright/index.mjs
          BINSO_UX_SERVER_FILE: ${{ runner.temp }}/binso-candidate/server.js
        run: node scripts/pwa-browser-test.mjs
      - name: Startup, session and persistent navigation regression
        env:
          BINSO_PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE: ${{ runner.temp }}/binso-browser/node_modules/playwright/index.mjs
          BINSO_UX_BROWSER: ${{ matrix.engine }}
          BINSO_UX_SERVER_FILE: ${{ runner.temp }}/binso-candidate/server.js
          BINSO_LOADING_OUTPUT: ${{ runner.temp }}/binso-ux-${{ matrix.engine }}/loading
        run: node scripts/loading-browser-test.mjs
      - name: Upload browser evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: ux-browser-${{ matrix.engine }}-${{ github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/binso-ux-${{ matrix.engine }}
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7
  ux-compliance:
    needs: [plan, checks, browser]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-node
      - name: Collect current browser measurements
        continue-on-error: true # Missing evidence is reported; the final quality job still blocks failed browsers.
        if: needs.plan.outputs.browser == 'true'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          pattern: ux-browser-*-${{ github.sha }}
          path: evidence/ux
      - name: Collect successful architecture lint evidence
        continue-on-error: true # A failed checks job may have no artifact; coverage remains untested.
        if: always()
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          name: ux-static-${{ github.sha }}
          path: evidence/ux/static
      - name: Generate individual requirement coverage and enforce measured failures
        env:
          RELEASE_GATE: ${{ github.event_name == 'release' || (github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') || inputs.level == 'full' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          EXTRA=()
          if [ "$RELEASE_GATE" = true ]; then EXTRA+=(--release); fi
          node scripts/compliance/visual.mjs evidence/ux ux-compliance/visual-baselines.v1.json evidence/ux/compliance-visual.json
          node scripts/compliance/report.mjs --static --gate "${EXTRA[@]}" evidence/ux --out docs/ux-compliance
      - name: Publish compliance report including failures and missing evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: ux-compliance-${{ github.sha }}
          path: docs/ux-compliance
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Add coverage summary
        if: always()
        run: cat docs/ux-compliance/report.md >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
  quality:
    # Keep the existing required job name. Failure, cancellation or an unexpected skip is blocking.
    needs: [plan, checks, build, browser, ux-compliance]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Enforce every mandatory result
        env:
          PLAN_RESULT: ${{ needs.plan.result }}
          CHECKS_RESULT: ${{ needs.checks.result }}
          UX_COMPLIANCE_RESULT: ${{ needs.ux-compliance.result }}
          BUILD_RESULT: ${{ needs.build.result }}
          BROWSER_RESULT: ${{ needs.browser.result }}
          BROWSER_REQUIRED: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.browser }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for result in "$PLAN_RESULT" "$CHECKS_RESULT" "$BUILD_RESULT" "$UX_COMPLIANCE_RESULT"; do
            if [ "$result" != success ]; then echo "::error::Required job ended with $result"; exit 1; fi
          done
          if [ "$BROWSER_REQUIRED" != true ] && [ "$BROWSER_REQUIRED" != false ]; then
            echo "::error::Missing or invalid browser-scope output"; exit 1
          fi
          if [ "$BROWSER_REQUIRED" = true ]; then
            test "$BROWSER_RESULT" = success || { echo "::error::Browser checks: $BROWSER_RESULT"; exit 1; }
          else
            test "$BROWSER_RESULT" = skipped || { echo "::error::Unexpected browser result: $BROWSER_RESULT"; exit 1; }
          fi
      - name: Download fully verified production candidate
        if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          name: binso-candidate-${{ github.sha }}
          path: deploy
      - name: Promote verified artifact for Azure (no rebuild)
        if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: binso-one-${{ github.sha }}
          path: deploy/binso-one.zip
          if-no-files-found: error
          compression-level: 0
          retention-days: 2

name: Retention Maintenance

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "17 2 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/retention-maintenance.yml
      - scripts/retention-cleanup.mjs

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  cleanup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@b906affcce14559ad1aafd4ab0e942779e9f58b1 # v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Remove expired authentication artifacts
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.DATABASE_URL }}
          DATABASE_SSL: "true"
          DATABASE_SSL_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED: "true"
          AUTH_ARTIFACT_RETENTION_DAYS: "7"
          EXPIRED_SESSION_RETENTION_DAYS: "30"
        run: pnpm retention:cleanup

name: Stripe Billing Configuration
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/stripe-configuration-audit.yml
      - scripts/stripe-configuration-audit.mjs
      - lib/server/stripe.ts
      - lib/server/env.ts
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write
jobs:
  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - uses: azure/login@a641126d1b8aa4d1fa005f4f92df94a3a4c4c906 # v3
        with:
          client-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          tenant-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          subscription-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}
      - name: Audit current Stripe production configuration without payments
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          SETTINGS_FILE="$(mktemp)"
          chmod 600 "$SETTINGS_FILE"
          trap 'rm -f "$SETTINGS_FILE"' EXIT
          az webapp config appsettings list \
            -g rg-binso-admin-prod \
            -n binso-admin-prod \
            --query "[?starts_with(name, 'STRIPE_') || name == 'APP_URL'].{name:name,value:value}" \
            -o json > "$SETTINGS_FILE"
          node scripts/stripe-configuration-audit.mjs "$SETTINGS_FILE"

notes: Inventory includes every statically reachable JSX element/prop/branch in the operator variant graph, all operator HTTP routes and all workflow sources. Dynamic links and data-driven repeated elements retain their source expressions.
This is a complete source catalog, not complete business acceptance. Existing integration tests and missing process contracts are recorded separately.
Table extraction can include non-SQL text; exact queries are in the recorded dependency files.
